buildCommand: if [ ! -d flutter ]; then curl -Lo flutter.tar.xz https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.24.5-stable.tar.xz && tar xf flutter.tar.xz; fi && export PATH="$PATH:$PWD/flutter/bin" && flutter --version && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=${API_BASE_URL}
